blocks.text: Washington, United States—US President Donald Trump heads to Kansas on Monday to open a seven-state campaign blitz through territory he carried in 2024, as dismal polls and unexpectedly tight races in Republican strongholds stoke fears of sweeping Democratic gains in November’s midterms. With 15 days until the November 3 vote, Trump’s rally on the outskirts of Wichita aims to shore up Senator Roger Marshall, who is locked in a dead heat with a Methodist megachurch pastor.
